author: rorupuntou
content:
Hey team! Whenever someone with write access has a spare moment, could I get a CI workflow run approval ("Approve and run") and a quick look at two small test-only PRs on `forks/bogota`, plus a `protocol-mesh` PR?

1. **PR #3935 (Resolves #3930 — EIP-155 >64-bit legacy Chain ID exceptions)**: <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3935>
   - Small (+12/-4) fix in `test_chain_id.py` following up on `tests@v21.0.2` (#3828): updates `smallest_65_bit_chain_id` (`2**64`) and `chain_id_plus_2_64` to accept `[INVALID_SIGNATURE_VRS, INVALID_CHAINID]` so both 64-bit bounds-checking clients (EELS/Nethermind/Nimbus) and 256-bit arithmetic clients (Erigon) pass, while keeping `largest_64_bit_chain_id` (`2**64 - 1`) strictly `INVALID_CHAINID`.

2. **PR #3945 (EIP-2537 `MAP_FP_TO_G1` & `MAP_FP2_TO_G2` negative boundary vectors)**: <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3945>
   - Rebased onto `forks/bogota` — adds 22 parameterized negative cases (66 Prague fixtures) across precompiles `0x10` and `0x11` covering dirty top-16-byte big-endian padding (`0..15` on `c0`, `64..79` on `c1`, high-bit `\x80`, mid-padding byte 8), simultaneous modulus overflows ($\ge P$), and truncated calldata (32B / 64B).

3. **`protocol-mesh` PR #2 (EIP-2537 8-client `xref` mapping & invariant fuzzer)**: <https://github.com/spencer-tb/protocol-mesh/pull/2>
   - Completes 100% of the cross-client EIP-2537 mappings (37 functions across all 8 execution clients in `xref/data/tree.json`) and adds `fuzz/fuzz_eip2537.py` (72/72 tests passing) checking algebraic invariants and non-canonical coordinate rejections.

All static checks and local `uv run fill` runs are green. Thanks!
